overall.summary: Two faults: the ST depression hinges are said to add risk only above about 1.1 mm, but the model starts adding at about 0.8 mm (claim C41 and three sentences); and the flat-ST-segment part is said to lower risk and make ST depression count less, but it raises risk and makes ST depression count more. The record, structure, closed forms, technical hypotheses and the other claims hold.
